[vc_row full_width="stretch_row_content_no_spaces" el_id="africon-page-row"][vc_column]
[vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
[vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
[vc_column_text css=".vc_custom_africon_speakers{margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;}"]
<div class="africon-page africon-speakers">
<div class="page-hero">
      <div class="container">
        <h1>Speakers</h1>
        
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="page-layout">
      <aside class="sidebar">
        <h3>Speakers</h3>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#keynote">Keynote Speakers</a></li>
          <li><a href="#invited">Invited Speakers</a></li>
        </ul>
      </aside>

      <div class="page-content">
        <h2 id="keynote">Keynote Speakers</h2>
        <p>
          IEEE AFRICON 2027 is proud to feature distinguished keynote speakers
          from academia and industry. Speaker announcements will be made
          progressively as confirmations are received.
        </p>

        <div class="speaker-card">
          <div class="speaker-photo"><i class="fa fa-user"></i></div>
          <div class="speaker-info">
            <h3>Keynote Speaker 1 – To Be Announced</h3>
            <div class="affiliation">Affiliation TBD</div>
            <p>
              Speaker details will be announced soon. IEEE AFRICON 2027 is
              committed to bringing world-class keynote presentations covering
              the latest advances in technology, engineering, and innovation
              relevant to the African context.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="speaker-card">
          <div class="speaker-photo"><i class="fa fa-user"></i></div>
          <div class="speaker-info">
            <h3>Keynote Speaker 2 – To Be Announced</h3>
            <div class="affiliation">Affiliation TBD</div>
            <p>
              Speaker details will be announced soon. Stay tuned for exciting
              keynote announcements from leading researchers and innovators.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="speaker-card">
          <div class="speaker-photo"><i class="fa fa-user"></i></div>
          <div class="speaker-info">
            <h3>Keynote Speaker 3 – To Be Announced</h3>
            <div class="affiliation">Affiliation TBD</div>
            <p>Speaker details will be announced soon.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <h2 id="invited" style="margin-top: 36px">Invited Speakers</h2>
        <div class="tba-notice">
          <i
            class="fa fa-clock"
            style="
              font-size: 28px;
              color: var(--ieee-blue);
              display: block;
              margin-bottom: 10px;
            "
          ></i>
          Invited speaker details will be announced after paper acceptance
          notifications.<br />
          Check back in <strong>August 2027</strong> for updates.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
</div>
[/vc_column_text]
[/vc_column][/vc_row]
